name: Marina Simakov
biography: Marina Simakov is a security researcher at Preempt, with a special interest in network security and authentication protocols. Prior to Preempt, Marina served as a Security Researcher at Microsoft for several years. She holds an M.Sc. in computer science, with several published articles, with a main area of expertise in graph theory. Marina previously spoke at various security conferences such as Black Hat, BlueHat IL and DEF CON.
